REPLACE-WITH-YOUR-FIRM-NAME policy for all Claude Code use.

Scope. Confine each session to one matter. Start the session in that matter's folder, not in a parent folder, a drive root or your home directory. Do not extend the working directory to reach another client's material.

Material you must not enter without the principal's prior written approval, recorded on the matter file: anything subject to a suppression or non-publication order; anything subject to the implied Harman undertaking not to use material produced under compulsion for a purpose extraneous to the proceeding; material produced on subpoena; and anything subject to a statutory prohibition on publication. Before any such approval is given the responsible practitioner must be satisfied that the information will remain within the controlled environment of the platform, that the supplier is bound by confidentiality restrictions so the data is neither made publicly available nor used to train any large language model, that it is used only in connection with that proceeding, and that it is not used to train the program or any model. Being told a tool is closed, ringfenced or confidential is not itself sufficient assurance, and the obligation is capable of being breached where outputs are later used for a different purpose.

Evidence. Do not generate the content of an affidavit, a witness statement or a character reference. Do not alter, embellish, strengthen, dilute or otherwise rephrase a witness's evidence. Do not draft or prepare any part of an expert report. Preparatory work is permitted.

Verification. Verify every citation, authority and legislative reference against the primary source before it is relied on. Verification must not be carried out solely by AI. Use of AI does not qualify or absolve any professional or ethical obligation to the court.

Records. Session transcripts are firm records. Do not copy them outside the firm's systems and do not use the feedback, bug or share commands.
